definition_en: the act of sending goods, or a batch of goods sent together
core_image: 吊机把一排货箱稳稳放上货轮甲板
scene: 港口仓库里，工人正在清点即将出口的纸箱。The shipment of coffee leaves the port on Friday.
sceneCN: 这里 shipment 是「装运」（第 1 个义项：把货物交给承运方运出的行为）；句意：这批咖啡的装运将在周五离港。

derivatives.zh: 用船运送；运送；shipment 的动词基础
重新装运；转运；re- 加 shipment

senses.title: The act of sending goods
senses.definition: the process of sending goods from one place to another, especially by sea
senses.definitionCN: 把货物从一地运往另一地的过程，尤指海运
senses.example: The contract fixes the shipment date at the end of May.
senses.exampleCN: 合同把装运日期定在五月底。
senses.why: Ship plus -ment names the action, so the act of sending goods comes first.
senses.whyCN: ship 加 -ment 先把动作变成名词，所以「装运」这一行为排在首位。

senses.title: A batch of goods sent
senses.definition: a quantity of goods sent together to one buyer
senses.definitionCN: 一起发给同一买家的若干货物
senses.example: The warehouse received a shipment of spare parts this morning.
senses.exampleCN: 仓库今早收到一批备件。
senses.why: -ment also names the result of the action, so the goods themselves become a shipment.
senses.whyCN: -ment 也能指动作的结果，所以被运走的货物本身也叫 shipment。

senses.title: A unit in trade documents
senses.definition: each separate consignment recorded as one unit in shipping and customs papers
senses.definitionCN: 在运输与海关单据上单独记录的一票货物
senses.example: The invoice lists three shipments to the same client.
senses.exampleCN: 发票列出了发给同一客户的三票货。
senses.why: Trade paperwork counts each dispatched lot as one shipment, a narrower counting sense.
senses.whyCN: 贸易单据把每一次发出的货记作一票，这是更窄的计数义项。

intro.en: Shipment is ship plus the noun suffix -ment; ship goes back to Old English scip, a sea-going vessel.
intro.cn: shipment 是 ship 加名词后缀 -ment；ship 可上溯到古英语 scip，意为航海船只。

items.en: The verb ship appears, meaning to load goods onto a vessel.
items.cn: 动词 ship 出现，意为把货物装上船。

items.en: -mentum is a Latin suffix that forms nouns of action or result.
items.cn: -mentum 是拉丁语后缀，构成表示动作或结果的名词。

items.en: -ment passes from Latin through French into English.
items.cn: -ment 经法语从拉丁语进入英语。

items.en: Shipment appears as a noun for the act of shipping goods.
items.cn: shipment 作为表示装运行为的名词出现。

items.en: Modern trade English extends the noun to the goods sent.
items.cn: 现代贸易英语把这个名词扩展到被运走的货物。

note.en: Shipment belongs to the ship family and sits close to words for goods in transit.
note.cn: shipment 属于 ship 词族，与表示「在运货物」的词相邻。

entries.definition: to send goods by sea or another carrier
a person or firm that sends goods
the movement of goods by sea
the goods carried by a ship or aircraft
a batch of goods sent to a buyer
goods carried by transport, or the charge for carrying them

normalIntro.en: Shipment is ship plus -ment, so the word names both the sending and the goods that are sent.
normalIntro.cn: shipment 是 ship 加 -ment，因此既指「运送」这一动作，也指被运走的货物。

normal.en: Shipment is ship plus -ment, the suffix that turns an action into a noun.
normal.cn: shipment 是 ship 加 -ment，这个后缀把动作变成名词。

normal.en: The shipment date is the day the goods must leave.
normal.cn: shipment date 是货物必须发出的日子。

normal.en: Port of shipment names where the goods are loaded.
normal.cn: port of shipment 指明货物装船的地点。

normal.en: A partial shipment sends only part of the order at one time.
normal.cn: partial shipment 一次只发出订单的一部分。

normal.en: Compare shipment with cargo: shipment stresses the sending, cargo stresses what is carried.
normal.cn: 对比 cargo：shipment 强调发送，cargo 强调被运的东西。

abstract.en: Picture a crane lifting containers onto a ship.
abstract.cn: 想象吊机把集装箱吊上货轮。

abstract.en: Picture a clerk counting boxes against a packing list.
abstract.cn: 想象职员照着装箱单清点纸箱。

abstract.en: Picture a bill of lading stamped at the port office.
abstract.cn: 想象港务办公室里给提单盖章。

examples.en: The supplier confirmed that the shipment would arrive on Monday.
examples.cn: 供应商确认这批货将在周一到达。

examples.en: Customs held the shipment for two days at the border.
examples.cn: 海关在边境扣留这批货两天。

examples.en: We split the order into two shipments to meet the deadline.
examples.cn: 为赶上截止日期，我们把订单拆成两批货。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「希普门特」——货物从「门」口装上船，特快发出；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 scip（船）→ 动词 ship（装船运送）→ ship + -ment（动作与结果名词后缀）→ shipment，核心义「把货物装上运输工具发出」。

sensesIntro.en: Shipment begins as the act of sending goods, then names the goods sent, and finally counts each dispatched lot in trade papers.
sensesIntro.cn: shipment 先指发送货物的行为，再指被发送的货物，最后在贸易单据里指每一票发出的货。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a crane lifting boxes onto a waiting ship.
core.cn: 核心意象：吊机把货箱吊上等在那里的货轮。

branches.en: The act of sending goods is the first sense.
branches.cn: 发送货物的行为是第一义项。

branches.en: The goods themselves are the result sense.
The trade unit is the counting sense in documents.
branches.cn: 贸易单据里的计数单位是第三义项。

branches.en: The act and the goods are two sides of one dispatch.
branches.cn: 动作与货物是同一次发送的两面。

branches.en: A batch of goods and a documented consignment overlap.
branches.cn: 一批货物与一票单据货物相互重叠。

intro.en: Shipment is ship, an Old English word for a vessel, plus the noun suffix -ment.
intro.cn: shipment 由 ship（古英语中表示船只的词）加名词后缀 -ment 构成。

latinIntro.en: The suffix -ment comes from Latin -mentum through French; ship itself is Germanic, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 后缀 -ment 经法语来自拉丁语 -mentum；ship 本身是日耳曼语词，并非拉丁语。

items.example: Ship is the Germanic base of the word.
items.exampleCN: ship 是这个词的日耳曼语基础。

items.example: The verb ship adds the action.
items.exampleCN: 动词 ship 加上动作义。

items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 标记发货的人。
